body.name: Jointly calibrated signed-cell-mean interval benchmark
body.construction: Set \(\overline h_{v,j}=N_{v,j}^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\mathbf1\{V_i=v,J_i=j,S_i=0,T_i=v\}R_i\) when \(N_{v,j}>0\), set \(\overline h_{v,j}=0\) otherwise, and set \(\widehat s_{v,j}=1\) when \(\overline h_{v,j}\ge0\) and \(\widehat s_{v,j}=-1\) otherwise. Define the unprojected endpoint centers \(\overline L_{n,m}=-b+(k/m)\sum_{j=1}^{m}\widehat s_{0,j}\overline h_{0,j}\) and \(\overline U_{n,m}=b-(k/m)\sum_{j=1}^{m}\widehat s_{1,j}\overline h_{1,j}\). Define \(\widehat\psi_{L,i}=8k\sum_{j=1}^{m}\widehat s_{0,j}\mathbf1\{V_i=0,J_i=j,S_i=0,T_i=0\}(R_i-\overline h_{0,j})\), \(\widehat\psi_{U,i}=-8k\sum_{j=1}^{m}\widehat s_{1,j}\mathbf1\{V_i=1,J_i=j,S_i=0,T_i=1\}(R_i-\overline h_{1,j})\), \(\widehat\sigma_L^2=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\widehat\psi_{L,i}^2\), and \(\widehat\sigma_U^2=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\widehat\psi_{U,i}^2\). Let \(\kappa_{\delta_0}=\Phi_{\mathrm N}^{-1}((1+\sqrt{1-\delta_0})/2)\). The named procedure is \[C^{\mathrm{sign}}_{n,m}=\left(\Pi_{[-b,-b+ka_m]}\left[\overline L_{n,m}\mathbin{-}\frac{\kappa_{\delta_0}\widehat\sigma_L}{\sqrt n},\overline L_{n,m}\mathbin{+}\frac{\kappa_{\delta_0}\widehat\sigma_L}{\sqrt n}\right],\;\Pi_{[b-ka_m,b]}\left[\overline U_{n,m}\mathbin{-}\frac{\kappa_{\delta_0}\widehat\sigma_U}{\sqrt n},\overline U_{n,m}\mathbin{+}\frac{\kappa_{\delta_0}\widehat\sigma_U}{\sqrt n}\right]\right),\] where \(\Pi_I[A]\) is the image of interval \(A\) under scalar projection onto \(I\).
